To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we propose a BCI-CPG model and a gait-transferable CPG network to generate different kinds of rhythmical locomotion for a snake-like robots.
we proposed a novel BCI-CPG model and a neuron network organized by BCI-CPGs in line with unilateral excitations, which are used for the locomotion pattern control of the snake robot.

## I Introduction
In summary, our research is concerned with

the modeling and control of a snake-like robots, which has the following contributions:
1) The locomotion mechanism of a snake is analyzed and the main functional features for its motor system are specified in detail;

the generation mechanism of different kinds of locomotion pattern of snake-like robot and the application of the BCI-CPG network in the control of the locomotion pattern of the snake-like robots, and provides a new way of thinking to design the control system of snake-like robots.
the generation mechanism and control of the locomotion pattern of the snake-like robots.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
this work has successfully developed a novel CPG model for the snake-like robot to achieve different kinds of rhythmical locomotion modes.
the BCI CPG model is an effective method to imitate the generation mechanism of snake-like rhythmic locomotion pattern.
the BCI-CPG model could be applied in the control system of the snake-like robots to imitate the locomotion pattern of the snake and switch automatically between the different patterns.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the rhythmic pattern generation of the snake-like robots could be realized through the CPG model, and the locomotion pattern of the snake-like can be switched through the neuron network organized with the BCI-CPG.

the BCI-CPG network could generate a wide variety of different rhythmic patterns and the locomotion pattern of the snake-like robots could be switched automatically by the CPG neuron networks organized in line with unilateral excitations.
we have developed an effective method for modeling the rhythmic locomotion of the snake-like robots.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the CPG network can be used to generate the rhythmic pattern in the locomotion of the snake-like robots.
the CPG network is able to generate different locomotion modes by changing the connection of the CPG neurons.
the CPG network is a powerful method for the control of the snake locomotion, and it is easy for the CPG to be implemented on a microcontroller.
